name: Trang An
kicker: Sampans rowed through the tower karst
summary: Sit in a sampan while a local guide rows you through the tower karst on sông Sào Khê. UNESCO’s current list puts the property at 6,226 ha with a 6,026 ha buffer. The 2014 decision prints 6,172 ha and a 6,079 ha buffer. The tourism page says about 12,252 ha, about 90 km southeast of Hà Nội. Skip it if you only want the Tam Coc boat.
dotReason: The sampan in the towers is the reason for the night
fee: 300,000 đồng for an adult over 1.3 m
getThere: From the valley if you sleep there. Minutes from the station are check on arrival.
heroCaption: Limestone towers, the river, and sampans at Tràng An

notice.title: The Tam Coc boat is a different ticket
notice.body: UNESCO includes Tam Coc–Bich Dong in the property. The Ngo Đồng boat, Đền Thái Vi, and chùa Bích Động stay on the Tam Coc page. Đảo Khê Cốc is a separate ticket on the same board page.

body: You sit low in the boat. Forested towers rise on both sides, up to 200 m on the UNESCO list, and the guide rows. The relics page names this water sông Sào Khê. The current World Heritage entry, after the 2016 boundary change, prints a property of 6,226 ha and a buffer of 6,026 ha, with about 14,000 residents. The 2014 inscription decision prints 6,172 ha and a buffer of 6,079 ha. The provincial tourism page says about 12,252 ha and does not say it added the two UNESCO lines. Keep all three figures.

A 2017 tourism itinerary prints 31 lakes and 48 caves, and names hang Địa Linh, hang Sinh Dược, and hang Mây, with a water cave of 2 km among them. UNESCO prints no cave count. Do not treat 31 and 48 as the World Heritage figure. The board’s ticket page prints no boat duration and no gate hour. Both are check on arrival.

The management board’s office is Số 6, Đường Tràng An, Phường Hoa Lư. The ticket hotline on the page updated 30 March 2026 is 19009251. The tourism support line for Tràng An is 02293.886.068. Use both numbers.

figures.caption: Sampans under a cliff at Tràng An, a different bend from the hero
figures.alt: Two sampans on the river beneath a limestone cliff and a banyan at Tràng An

gettingThere: Sleep in the Hoa Lư valley and the wharf is the first move. From Ga Ninh Bình you need a ride. No minute from the station was printed. Check on arrival. The tourism page puts the landscape about 90 km southeast of Hà Nội. Bái Đính’s about 100 km is a different end. Do not average them.

legs.heading: From Hanoi
legs.body: By train to Ga Ninh Bình, then a ride. SE7 is 06:00–08:16, 2 hours 16 minutes, at kilometre 115. Road minutes to the wharf were not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the valley
legs.body: Walk or ride to the Tràng An wharf if you slept near it. A wharf hour was not on the ticket page. Check on arrival.

closed: No weekly closing day was printed. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: Board page updated 30 March 2026. Adult over 1.3 m: 300,000 đồng. Child from 1 m to 1.3 m: 150,000 đồng. Under 1 m free. Đảo Khê Cốc, separate: adult 100,000 đồng, child from 1 m to 1.3 m 50,000 đồng, under 1 m free. Hotline 19009251. Support phone 02293.886.068. No gate hour and no boat duration were printed. Check on arrival.
